1. IMMEDIATE ACTIONS (0-15 minutes): ☐ Isolate affected systems immediately ☐ Preserve evidence and system logs ☐ Activate cyber incident response team ☐ Notify CISO and security team ☐ Document initial findings
2. ASSESSMENT PHASE (15-60 minutes): ☐ Determine scope of compromise ☐ Identify attack vectors and methods ☐ Assess data exposure risk ☐ Check backup systems integrity ☐ Contact external security experts if needed
3. CONTAINMENT (1-4 hours): ☐ Block malicious network traffic ☐ Reset compromised credentials ☐ Apply security patches if applicable ☐ Implement additional monitoring ☐ Prepare communication plan
4. RECOVERY PLANNING: ☐ Develop system restoration timeline ☐ Test backup systems ☐ Plan phased service restoration ☐ Coordinate with business units ☐ Schedule security validation

1. INITIAL RESPONSE (0-30 minutes): ☐ Assess service impact and affected users ☐ Check system monitoring and alerts ☐ Contact technical teams ☐ Activate backup systems if available ☐ Document service disruption timeline
2. DIAGNOSIS (30-90 minutes): ☐ Identify root cause of disruption ☐ Check infrastructure dependencies ☐ Review recent changes or deployments ☐ Test alternative service paths ☐ Estimate recovery time
3. MITIGATION ACTIONS: ☐ Implement workaround solutions ☐ Redirect traffic to backup systems ☐ Communication to affected users ☐ Update stakeholders on status ☐ Monitor system performance
4. RECOVERY EXECUTION: ☐ Execute planned recovery steps ☐ Test service functionality ☐ Gradually restore full service ☐ Monitor for recurring issues ☐ Document lessons learned

1. SAFETY FIRST (0-10 minutes): ☐ Ensure personnel safety and evacuation if needed ☐ Contact emergency services if required ☐ Account for all staff and visitors ☐ Secure hazardous materials ☐ Activate emergency communication systems
2. SITUATION ASSESSMENT (10-45 minutes): ☐ Assess facility damage and accessibility ☐ Check critical infrastructure status ☐ Evaluate IT systems and data center ☐ Contact utility providers ☐ Document initial damage assessment
3. BUSINESS CONTINUITY ACTIVATION: ☐ Activate alternate work locations ☐ Switch to backup IT systems ☐ Notify key customers and suppliers ☐ Implement emergency procedures ☐ Coordinate with local authorities
4. RECOVERY COORDINATION: ☐ Plan facility restoration timeline ☐ Arrange temporary accommodation ☐ Coordinate with insurance providers ☐ Manage supply chain disruptions ☐ Plan phased return to normal operations
